sources.evidence: Bakkafrost's current 2025 certification overview lists Glyvrar as a Bakkafrost Faroe Islands processing factory with current BRC GS, IFS, Global G.A.P./VLOG, ASC Chain of Custody, Kosher, SEDEX and Non-GMO certifications, and its effluent data identifies harvest and VAP processing at the Glyvrar processing plant.

Bakkafrost's official history identifies primary processing and value-added processing at Glyvrar and describes the Glyvrar harvest/VAP facility; the current 2026 open-house programme also invites visitors to Bakkafrost's operating facility at Glyvrar.

Bakkafrost's current fresh-products page states that whole salmon, fillets and portions are harvested and processed in Bakkafrost facilities and chilled for shipment from the Faroe Islands; its current frozen-products page lists whole frozen salmon, fillets and portions among the product portfolio.
